import json,time,os,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
R=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'scripts'))
from lossless_native import ref, fingerprint
Q=R/'.cache/quality-20261107/V185-addition-storage-forecast-v1';Q.mkdir()
os.nice(10);os.sched_setaffinity(0,[6,7])
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
a=R/'.cache/quality-20261107/V184-wave-readout-trial-v1/scores-v1.json'
b=R/'.cache/quality-20261107/V183-coherent-pair-evidence-trial-v1/scores-v1.json'
new,base=read(a),read(b);old=read(R/'.cache/quality-20261107/V185-native-storage-forecast-v1/result-v1.json')
rows=[]
for cid,bs in new['native_predictions'].items():
 binding=base['native_predictions'][cid]['V183-coherent-pair-EMA'];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
 inherited=np.load(binding['path'],allow_pickle=False)
 for e in ['raw','EMA']:
  name=f'V184-wave-readout-{e}';pr,wa=bs[name],bs[name+'-wave']
  assert ref(pr['path'])==pr and ref(wa['path'])==wa
  value=np.load(pr['path'],allow_pickle=False);wave=np.load(wa['path'],allow_pickle=False)
  actual=np.add(inherited,wave,dtype=np.float32)
  rows.append({'id':cid,'endpoint':e,'RGB':pr,'wave':wa,'baseline':binding,'values':fingerprint(value),'addition_bit_exact':fingerprint(value)==fingerprint(actual),'channels':value.size})
assert all(r['addition_bit_exact'] for r in rows)
wave_bytes=sum(r['sizes']['zlib_byteplanes'] for r in old['rows'] if r['kind']=='wave')
r={'status':'pass-completed-native-72-bit-exact-addition-recipes-not-new-quality','source':dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'previous_forecast':ref(R/'.cache/quality-20261107/V185-native-storage-forecast-v1/result-v1.json'),'scores':ref(a),'baseline_scores':ref(b),'rows':rows,'arrays':144,'RGB_arrays':len(rows),'RGB_channels_checked':sum(r['channels'] for r in rows),'wave_compressed_bytes':wave_bytes,'native_forecast_35percent_and_manifests_bytes':int(wave_bytes*1.35)+144*2048,'new_neural_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,'scope':'Future RGB manifest may bind exact FP32 addition of immutable baseline and stored wave. Each future array must pass byte digest equality; otherwise codec stores XOR bytes. Every old array remains unchanged. Wave entropy can change; measured forecast is not a bound.'}
assert 'torch' not in sys.modules
with (Q/'result-v1.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print({k:r[k] for k in ['RGB_arrays','RGB_channels_checked','wave_compressed_bytes','native_forecast_35percent_and_manifests_bytes']})
